recognize_zh: 高倍下片狀不黏聚的腫瘤細胞，細胞質豐富、核偏位並常有核周淡染區（perinuclear hof），細胞核大小差異明顯，上方可見多核巨大腫瘤細胞，並有深染核與核分裂像，符合退行性（anaplastic）漿細胞。
features: Sheets of discohesive large cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei
Perinuclear clearing (hof) evident in a subset of cells, supporting plasmacytic differentiation
Marked nuclear pleomorphism with hyperchromatic, irregular and multinucleated giant tumor cells
Prominent nucleoli in some nuclei and scattered mitotic figures, including possible atypical forms
Focal collagenous dermal stroma in the center with a few admixed granulocytes
describe_en: High-power view of the dermal infiltrate shows sheets of discohesive large cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm and eccentric nuclei, many with a perinuclear hof. There is marked nuclear pleomorphism, including hyperchromatic irregular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and multinucleated giant tumor cells, along with scattered mitotic figures. A small band of residual dermal collagen is present centrally. Findings are consistent with anaplastic plasma cell neoplasm involving the skin (cutaneous plasma cell myeloma), with immunophenotypic confirmation recommended.

ddx.vs: ALCL hallmark cells have horseshoe-shaped nuclei with strong CD30 and often ALK positivity, while myeloma cells are CD138/MUM1-positive with cytoplasmic light-chain restriction (note both can be EMA-positive).

Plasmablastic lymphoma shows more monomorphic immunoblastic cells, a starry-sky pattern and EBER positivity in immunocompromised patients, rather than bizarre multinucleated plasma cells in known myeloma.
Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters and is cytokeratin-positive, whereas these cells are discohesive with plasmacytoid hofs and keratin-negative.
Pleomorphic sarcoma cells are spindled to bizarre in fascicles or storiform arrays and lack CD138/light-chain expression.
